findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.comment: Observed walk in freezer to have ice accumulation to be present under fan unit. Discussed with PIC, freezer will be serviced. Ensure equipment is working at manufactures level.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.11(A) Good Repair and Proper Adjustment. (A) EQUIPMENT shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed dish machine to test at 0 ppm CL. Discussed with PIC, dish machine will be serviced. Facility will continue to use dish machine, but will be using the triple sink to sanitize all dishes. Ensure dish machine is working up to the manufactures standards and at the proper concentration (100ppm CL).
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (A) A chlorine solution shall have a minimum temperature based on the concentration and PH of the solution as listed in the chart in 4-501.114 (A).

findings.title: Utensils, equipment, and linens: properly stored, dried, and handled.
findings.comment: Observed multiple drawers holding cleaned utensil to have food debris accumulation. Discussed with PIC, drawers will be cleaned and utensil will be put through the wash, rinse, and sanitize process. Ensure all clean utensil are stored in a way that prevents any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 4-903.11(A) Equipment, Utensils, Linens, and Single-Service and Single-Use Articles. (A) Except as specified in (D) of this section, cleaned EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, laundered LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be stored: (1) In a clean, dry location; (2) Where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination; and (3) At least 15 cm (6 inches) above the floor.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices.
findings.comment: Observed a leak to be present at the back triple sink. Discussed with PIC, leak will be serviced. Ensure a licensed plumber services leak and facility to continue to monitor plumbing for any possible leaks.
findings.citation_text: 5-202.11(A) Approved System and Cleanable Fixtures. (A) A PLUMBING SYSTEM shall be designed, constructed, and installed according to LAW.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
Observed caulking to be in a state of disrepair in the following locations:
1) Black mold was observed to be present at the caulking to the left of the dish machine. 
2) Caulking was observed to be soiled with food debris at the back kitchen hand sink. 

Discussed with PIC, caulking will be replaced. Ensure facility is monitoring/replacing caulking as needed.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (100ppm), and pH (10). (B) Iodine shall have 68F, pH of 5 or less and concentration of 12.5ppm and 25ppm. (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label, and water with 500ppm hardness or less. (D) - (E) Meets EPA-label use and regulatory authority approval. (P) (F) Other chemical sanitzers in-use shall have EPA-registered label, display device registration number on devide and is operated and maintained in accordance with manufacturers instructions (Pf)

Observed the dish machine to not be sanitizing with bleach properly. Machine was run several times and only 10 ppm of bleach was observed. Facility used personal test strips as well, same results. Maintenance was called to look at machine. Inspector suggested calling a professional service provider if issue cannot be rectified by maintenance. Sanitizer line was corrected during the inspection by the maintenance staff - 200 ppm. COS.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (100ppm), and pH (10). (B) Iodine shall have 68F, pH of 5 or less and concentration of 12.5ppm and 25ppm. (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label, and water with 500ppm hardness or less. (D) - (E) Meets EPA-label use and regulatory authority approval. (P) (F) Other chemical sanitzers in-use shall have EPA-registered label, display device registration number on devide and is operated and maintained in accordance with manufacturers instructions (Pf)

Observed the 3 compartment sink in the kitchen to have 0 ppm of quaternary ammonium. Several tests were taken with test strips with multiple fills/disposal of the basin. Inspector showed PIC. New bucket of sanitizer was put on recently. It appears the line is not pulling the sanitizer through to the dispenser. Discussed with PIC. PIC is contacting maintenance to rectify the issue. Inspector will follow-up on 10/10/23.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions. 

Observed the snack bar hand sink to have ice dumped within the basin. Cease practice. Hand sink is for hand washing only. Ensure all students and staff are aware of this policy. Ice should not be dumped within the hand sink (utilize a dump sink). Discussed with PIC. COS.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. (B) In TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, floor may be material effectively treated to control dust and mud. Walls and ceilings may be material that protects interior from weather and windblown dust and debris. 

Observed the following areas in need of repair (no longer smooth, easily cleanable, non-absorbent):
1. Caulking at the dish machine is coming away from the wall and/or molding in front of the spray nozzle area. The area of the dish machine next to the hand sink is missing caulking. Repair both areas.
2. The mop room is missing coving as you enter to the left along that entire wall. Ensure coving is installed so the floor and wall are smooth and easily met.
3. The wall of the dry storage area has damage and dry wall needs repaired. Visible holes/damage on the wall above the coving. 

Ensure building repairs before the next routine inspection. Discussed with PIC. Ensure maintenance staff is aware of these corrections.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-702.11: UTENSILS and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be SANITIZED before use after cleaning. 

On arrival, the dish machine is using a sanitizer that uses quaternary ammonia as its active ingredient. After consulting CK, this is not a sanitizer intended for dish machines. PIC instructed to acquire a sanitizer intended for dish machines. PIC will use the three part sink for sanitizing until new solution can be acquired. PIC will notify inspector when the new solution is acquired and installed and a spot check will take place at that time.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
3-302.11: (A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display (P). (3) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by cleaning visibly soiled containers, removing damaged containers, separating washed and unwashed produce (C).  

Pink slime is observed on the deflector shield of the ice machine. Discussed with the PIC and the item was cleaned during the inspection. PIC instructed to clean regularly.

findings.title: Wholesome, sound condition
findings.comment:
750-100 Food shall be in sound condition, free from spoilage, filth, and other contamination and shall be safe for human consumption.

Observed a container of condensed milk in the walk in cooler to have green mold growing in it. Discussed with the PIC and the food was discarded during the inspection.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
750-830g A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million. 

During the inspection the sink sanitizing station was observed to be using Quat sanitizer, but only chlorine test strips could be found at this time. PIC stated that the correct test strips would be ordered immediately.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
REPEAT: Observed the gauge on the dish machine to not be correlated with the temperature inside. A heat test strip was used and the dish machine is reading 180F. Make sure to fix gauge to measure 180F for the dish machine.
750-830c A thermometer ±3°F shall be provided to check the temperature of  the water in each tank of the dish machine and the temperature of  the final rinse water as it enters the manifold.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
Observed prep sink to be leaking water. Repair leak in the prep sink.
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

750-830c A thermometer ±3°F shall be provided to check the temperature of  the water in each tank of the dish machine and the temperature of  the final rinse water as it enters the manifold.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
1) Observed the waste water flowing on the floor underneath the dish machine.  A basin should be used to catch water to flow properly.  
2) Observed the drain and hoses next to the ice machine to have heavy mold accumulation.  Clean the drain and orange piece to remove the visible mold and soil.
750-1200 All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed the table holding the coffee brewer to be pulling away from the wall. Reattached table to wall and caulk joint to make for a smooth and easily cleanable surface.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
Observed a leak at the dish machine. Repair leak.
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Presence of insects/rodents.  Animals prohibited
findings.comment:
Mouse droppings found in the following areas:
1) In catering dish cabinet in center of kitchen. 2) corner of storage room on floor. 3) on oil bottles in storage room. 4) wheels on shelving units in storage room. 5) floor behind storage room shevles. 6) on container of cake sprinkles. 7) on container of baking soda.

Hire a licensed Pest Control Operator and show written proof of their treatment and clean up droppings in these areas.

750-.1160 Effective measures intended to minimize the presence of rodents, flies, roaches, insects on the premises shall be utilized

findings.title: Outer openings protected from insects, rodent proof
findings.comment:
Gaps under brown double doors to garage. Seal the gaps to keep mice out, and so no daylight shows through.
750- .1170 All outer openings shall be protected against the entrance of vermin and insects by tight fitting self-closing doors/screens.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.comment:
Wet mop stored in mop bucket in back room. Mops must be hung to dry. 
Unused freezer in corner. Remove from premises.
750-.1390 Maintenance & cleaning tools shall be stored so to not contaminate food, utensils, equipment, or linens/ stored orderly.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed hood system to have accumulation of grease and dust. Clean hood system.
750-.800e All non-food contact surfaces shall be properly cleaned.

Clean all soiled floors.
750-.1220 Floors shall be kept free of accumulated soil, dirt, and food debris.
